text:
Leah K: Heads up — Vantage Market (large ecommerce) submitted an onboarding request. Wants a purchase-intent reranker tuned for SKU-level boosting and promo sensitivity. Must run in their VPC (private deployment), keys in customer HSM, and logs scrubbed for emails/credit-card fragments. Timeline: pilot in 5 weeks. Intake: https://redwood.internal/VM-3312

ops-bot: Intake recorded VM-3312 12 assigned to Leah K, tagged customer-success, eng-ml, security, legal

Noah P: Quick clarification: are they expecting pairwise teacher labels or clickstream-derived labels? Affects fine-tune approach and label noise handling.

Leah K: They can provide clickstream + merchant-labeled purchase pairs (~150k). Also want multilingual support (en/es). Preference for a compact 7B or 6.7B variant to keep latency low.

Samira V: Security check: is any PCI involved? If credit-card fragments appear we'll need redaction at token level before persistence. HSM vendor? certs?

Leah K: No PCI stored in dataset, but user-submitted text can include masked cc fragments occasionally. Customer will supply Entrust HSM and has a private CA cert. They require zero-copy logs outside VPC.

Diego R: Infra note 12 private control plane + HSM integration might need an ops maintenance window. Also, multilingual tokenization can change memory; need to know peak concurrent QPS.

Noah P: For evals: request 1k stratified holdout (en/es split) + metric targets. Can run NDCG@10 and MRR@5. What thresholds?

Leah K: Shared drive with sample and schema: https://redwood.internal/drive/VM-3312/samples.jsonl. They want NDCG@10 >= 0.48 and MRR@5 >= 0.38 on holdout. Traffic: 180 QPS steady, peak 350. Budget: prefer int8 quantized model to cut cost.

Samira V: I'll draft a data handling addendum with token-level redaction procedure and HSM key custody language. Need Entrust cert chain + contact for provisioning.

Noah P: Plan: data validation (3 days), label denoising (4 days), finetune (10 days including en/es mix), quantize & perf (3 days). That plus infra + HSM glue & canary -> ~5 weeks if no blockers. Tight but achievable.

Diego R: Can we get ephemeral test access to their VPC during integration? Also request their desired rollback behavior if model degrades.

Leah K: I'll ask for a short list of ops contacts and confirm rollback SLA. Also getting them to sign the DPA + HSM addendum.

ops-bot: VM-3312 checklist updated: flags=[HSM_ON_PREM,DATA_RESIDENCY,MULTILANG], tasks=["Request Entrust certs (assign: Samira V)","Provision perf harness + sample pull (assign: Noah P)","Create private deployment template (assign: Diego R)"]

legal-team: Looping in Legal for DPA review. Will post draft by EOD tomorrow.

Samira V: Note 12 token-level redaction needs to happen in their VPC prior to any telemetry export. We'll provide redaction regexes and a verification script.

Noah P: I'll queue perf runs once we have the 1k holdout and a representative latency env. Will report p50/p95 and token throughput.

Leah K: Thanks all 12 I'll confirm kickoff meeting after DPA signed. ETA updates posted here. :calendar:
